slice: DWG LAYOUT viewport-list reverse membership closure
problem: Preflight checked that listed viewport handles resolved, but did not check that every retained paper-space VIEWPORT owned by that LAYOUT appeared in the list.

spec_evidence.source: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1, §20.4.84 (see preceding PAR-20/7G.3 receipt for local PDF identity and hash)
spec_evidence.contract: R2004+ LAYOUT records carry a viewport count followed by that many soft-pointer viewport handles. Local validation enforces exact set correspondence, but whether the DWG sequence order has independent consumer semantics remains unresolved; it is not assumed to map to DXF output order, status, or identity.

changes: Build and sort a viewport-handle-to-LAYOUT ownership index from typed DWG LAYOUT records.
Reject duplicate declarations across LAYOUT lists.
Require each emitted paper-space VIEWPORT to appear in the declared list of its resolved reciprocal LAYOUT.
Compare each LAYOUT's declared membership count with its emitted owned paper-space VIEWPORT set.
Keep DXF groups 68/69 derived from the established output-order projection, independent of DWG list order.
implementation.failure_atomicity: Generated control verifies invalid membership leaves the existing destination sentinel unchanged.
implementation.test: tests/dxf_fixture_tests.cpp::testDwgViewportProjection; locally generated in-memory graph; no fixture file or CTest registration added.
implementation.empty_entity_case: The generated control also temporarily removes every retained paper-space VIEWPORT while keeping non-empty LAYOUT lists. Composed export rejects atomically because validateLayoutGraph resolves list targets before prepareDwgViewportProjection's no-viewport fast return; no additional production change was needed for this case.

regression.before_fix: The generated ASCII and Binary DXF paths accepted Sheet A viewport list {0x700}, count 1 while retained same-layout VIEWPORT 0x705 was omitted.
regression.after_fix: Both encodings reject the omitted member atomically; valid two-layout projections still write and read back. A separate generated case with all retained paper-space VIEWPORT entities temporarily removed still rejects the nonempty LAYOUT lists at the earlier validateLayoutGraph gate.

fixture_policy: Only locally authored in-memory graph controls were used. No external DWG/DXF was downloaded, copied, or committed; no new fixture or test registration was added.
evidence_ceiling: Typed membership/owner closure and generated ASCII/Binary serializer round-trip only; no native consumer, full-file conversion, independent semantic support, or 3D support claim.
next_unresolved: Determine composed DXF representation policy for any DWG-only LAYOUT viewport-list semantics without conflating them with DXF groups 68/69.
repository_state: Broadly dirty shared worktree; this slice is uncommitted and nothing was staged.
